lines: Brown has played 4 of NE's 10 games. Over his last 3 he saw 7.3 targets a game, up from 6.5 on the season.
He's caught 2.7 passes for 34.0 yards a game lately, and averages 6.1 PPR points. He has no touchdowns this season.
NE has a bye in Wk 11. The coach said Brown's injury severity will be determined after the team returns from Munich.
